notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide (src/AttachedGuide.tsx, registered in src/guides/attached.guide.tsx) and docs/evidence/attached.md at 4e470cf (“docs: adopt Biscuit's main at 3795b4c”, 2 October), which only moved the Sources date to 1 October. The Sources note was checked on 1 October 2026 against jfs-components 0.1.78 (the evidence's “0.1.78 check”: mirror tag v0.1.78, built from Biscuit's fix/component-bugs-v0.1.78 at 5b6894b), so items citing it carry 2026-10-01 and 0.1.78-5b6894b. The evidence's other section (22 September, 0.1.60) is not cited: its facts are either in the package types (children, badge, nine positions, circular, badgeSize, badgeRadius, modes) or restated by the 1 October Sources note. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). Unchanged since the check, read on GitHub (spiefi/coin-components): src/components/Attached/Attached.tsx has the same blob (3e0dad2) at v0.1.78, v0.1.78-3795b4c and v0.1.78-dbe0e02, and its last commit is the 0.1.77 build (1f05631, 28 September); IconCapsule.tsx (f4496d2) and utils/react-utils.ts (bd10632) are the same at v0.1.78 and v0.1.78-dbe0e02; the attached/* variables in Coin Variables-variables-full.json are identical at both tags. Installed Attached.tsx matches every guide sentence used here, read from source, not run: the root is a View with position relative and alignSelf flex-start, so it hugs the main child (242, 261–265); the main child is measured (onMainLayout, 153–156, 243) and sets the size; the badge is absolutely positioned with its centre on the anchor, so it straddles the edge and adds nothing to the layout footprint (210–239, 244–256); it stays at opacity 0 until both are measured (236–237); position has nine values, default bottom-right (18–27, 135); circular (default true, 136) projects only diagonal anchors onto the inscribed circle, and edge and centre anchors are the same either way (216–230); the ring is an outside border on the badge from attached/slot/border and attached/slot/borderWidth (191–208, 253), which the package resolver gives as rgb(255,255,255), 2 px, with no modes (Attached Border True, the default) and transparent with Attached Border False; both slots get Attached's merged modes through cloneChildrenWithModes, the child's own modes winning (142–148, 163–170; react-utils.ts 59–65). There is no loading, disabled or pressed state and no event prop. IconCapsule reads its circle from iconCapsule/size and iconCapsule/radius (9999 means size/2) before a style override is merged (IconCapsule.tsx 33–42, 103–106): Icon Capsule Size M is 42 px (the default) and XS is 18 px, both radius 9999, so a style width or height would break the circle, as the Sources note says. ic_cart and ic_rupee are in the installed icon set (src/icons/registry.ts lines 940 and 3964). The published Storybook (index.json, last modified 17 October 2026) still has every Attached story the Sources note names (default, all-positions, square-vs-circular, enforced-image-badge, capsule-badge), so no stale-Storybook gap. No guide sentence is contradicted by the installed build, so no guide fix is proposed. Not recorded: badgeSize and badgeRadius (the fixed badge box), style and the inherited View props, the Attached Border mode, and the guide's Configuration labels as mode names, which the guide doesn't cover; the 22 September evidence's Figma node detail (42 px main slot, 16 px attachment reference) and its note on the capsule story's 56 px and 22 px style sizes, which the Sources note already summarises; the Sources line “The package defaults circular to true”, which the circular fact already gives. Anatomy: none of the three parts is always present: children and badge are optional props, and the ring is drawn only around a badge. The guide gives no accessibility guidance (the examples' accessibilityLabel on IconCapsule is not rendered: IconCapsule.tsx 85–88 drops it), so accessibility stays empty and is flagged. content.good and content.bad are empty: the guide's copy is about the badge's meaning, and its specimens are icons and a list row's title, not badge copy. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every Attached, IconCapsule, ListItem and MoneyValue), no modes on Attached, and no modes on the main IconCapsule (Icon Capsule Size M is its default). The badge IconCapsule sets Icon Capsule Size XS, the one mode in the examples, because the Sources note says the guide uses the native M and XS sizes rather than style dimensions and the Do “Keep the badge compact” needs the smaller capsule. The In context row drops the guide's trailing MoneyValue (no entry in this pack) and its accessibilityLabel, which named the amount; ListItem has an undocumented entry and takes its props. Copy and glyphs are the guide's own (Card payment, Today · Food, ic_cart main, ic_rupee badge). Left out of examples (three at most): the nine-position grid, the Bounding box corner, the centred and clipped Don'ts and the playground.

useWhen.text: Add a subordinate signal to a main item without altering its footprint.

useWhen.text: Keep a small qualifier, such as a payment type or status, attached to the item it describes.

from.quote: The badge adds a small qualification such as payment type or status while the central mark remains easy to recognize.

avoidWhen.text: The extra signal is the item's primary label or would become a second focal point: the badge stays subordinate to the main item.

anatomy.holds: The child in the main slot (children): it establishes the size and is the visual object people identify first.

from.quote: The child in the main slot establishes the size and the visual object people identify first.

anatomy.holds: The badge slot: centred on the selected anchor, so it can straddle the main edge.

examples.purpose: The guide's composition: a main IconCapsule at its default size with a compact IconCapsule badge (Icon Capsule Size XS) on the default bottom-right anchor, projected onto the circle's edge.
examples.jsx:
<Attached badge={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_rupee" modes={{ 'Icon Capsule Size': 'XS' }} />}>
  <IconCapsule iconName="ic_cart" />
</Attached>

from.quote: this guide uses the native Icon Capsule Size modes M and XS so both child capsules keep their component-owned circular geometry.
